selected_evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version during updates
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the persistent lock, newer available curl builds, and a real locked update completing with nothing to do while curl remains 0:7.76.1-40.el9.x86_64.

Records healthy pre-restart state and boot ID 34027437-307c-4f58-bdb2-1fe626bb2d66, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID e3f45eb4-b53f-4079-834d-086b6fa3374c, running system health, functional curl, persistent versionlock, and unchanged package version after another update attempt.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- os ---'
sed -n '1,8p' /etc/os-release
printf '%s\n' '--- boot ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- curl packages ---'
rpm -q curl libcurl --qf '%{NAME} %{EPOCHNUM}:%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}.%{ARCH}\n'
printf '%s\n' '--- package manager/versionlock ---'
command -v dnf
dnf --version | sed -n '1,2p'
rpm -q 'dnf-command(versionlock)' || true
dnf versionlock list 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' '--- health baseline ---'
systemctl is-system-running || true
systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager || true
